scope: October 13, 2025 Law: common rules, Standard Setup, four base factions, Fall/Autumn and Winter, Thief/Tinker/Ranger, core dominance/coalitions. Excludes expansions, second Vagabond, other characters/maps, hirelings, landmarks, bots and Advanced Setup.
method: Read full candidate09 and exact diff against assigned candidate08. Independently rechecked all revised rules against authoritative extracted text and PDF text, especially 3.2.1 and 9.2.9.IIIa scoring. Unchanged material retains the full independent applicable-source audit conducted in this same session (chapters 1–9 excluding 9.7, C.1, applicable glossary, M.1–M.2, V.1–V.3, with PDF glyph inspection). Only assigned summaries and authoritative sources read; no questions/keys, reader outputs/grades or review reports. Summary not edited.

checked_claims.claim_group: Crafting from hand and faction timing
checked_claims.checked: Crafting card starts in hand, when faction turn permits; Marquise workshop/Eyrie roost/Alliance sympathy identities unchanged.
Cost is activation matching bottom-left crafting icons; spending the card suit is not the crafting payment.
One matching crafting-piece activation per icon; eligible pieces can be combined.
Each piece uses its own clearing suit; Vagabond pawn uses current clearing.
Each ordinary crafting piece activates once per turn.
One face-up undamaged hammer exhausted for every icon, activating pawn; pawn ignores normal once-per-turn cap.
Current clearing must match all icons, so mixed fox/rabbit/mouse cannot be paid there; question mark accepts any suit.
Resolve immediate effect then discard card to shared discard. Ambush/dominance are uncraftable, so no dominance-discard exception changes this crafting-card route.

checked_claims.claim_group: Crafted item route, availability and points
checked_claims.checked: Corresponding item must exist in map supply, moves to ordinary Crafted Items, remains distinct from discarded card; Vagabond takes item face up into Satchel/track; Eyrie point exception preserved.

checked_claims.claim_group: Persistent crafting card route and duplicates
checked_claims.checked: Persistent card goes hand to play area and grants text; duplicate ban and restrictions on using play-area cards retained.
Vagabond item exhaustion rules belong to Vagabond; ordinary crafted items remain in Crafted Items rather than becoming general action payments.
Card matches clearing containing a roost; place one warrior at one chosen roost, or two there with Charismatic. Full-placement requirement preserved.
Card matches origin, not destination; at least one warrior moves, obeying normal adjacency/path/rule.
Card matches battle clearing; Eyrie warriors and enemy required to initiate.
Card matches target; rule target, open slot, no existing roost; place one roost.
Craft first then Recruit/Move/Battle/Build, all cards each column in chosen order; immediate turmoil if any action cannot fully complete.
Four ruins and distinct R bag/boot/hammer/sword, one item under each; map supply unchanged.

checked_claims.claim_group: Hidden ruin shuffle, return and timing
checked_claims.checked: Randomize ruin/item stacks and return each to empty ruin slot during Vagabond faction setup; no Vagabond means no instruction that populates ruins.

No ordinary VP award is attached to removal of a warrior: ordinary removal VP is zero. This is a deduction from the explicit limited building/token scoring rule, not a claim that faction/card abilities can never score warrior removals.
One VP per enemy building removed, including outside battle or while defending.
One VP per enemy token removed; items remain expressly excluded from enemy pieces earlier in summary.
General removal award is distinct from faction/card scoring; Despot and Infamy supply explicit faction examples of additional points.

One extra per Hostile piece removed in battle on Vagabond own turn, with first hostility-causing warrior excluded; no added ordinary warrior point. Eligible hostile warrior totals one Infamy, eligible building/token normally totals one ordinary plus one Infamy.

snapshot_fidelity.comparison: Exact line diff checked: only the hidden-ruin reference, crafting table and component routing, Decree procedure table, and ordinary removal VP clarification changed. Other contents match candidate08.

source_gaps.gap: The Law references but does not reproduce exact physical faction-board cost/VP/draw tracks or relationship Aid thresholds/advancement VP. Summary refers to printed spaces; no values invented.
Complete shared-deck and quest card faces are absent, so individual crafting requirements/card effects/quest pairs must come from cards; procedures are supported.
60–90 minute catalog duration is not stated in supplied Law; unverified metadata, not a gameplay-rule finding.

conclusion: All revised statements supported. In particular ordinary warrior removal is 0 VP, while enemy building/token removal is 1 VP each; Infamy and other faction/card scoring remain additional. No material contradiction or important in-scope procedural omission found.
